core_rule: Canonical Plans define capability lanes and role contracts; exact provider/model defaults are bound from the user's configured providers/accounts/model profiles in Settings.
fallback_policy: If a noncritical low-cost lane is unconfigured, Orchestrator may offer to bind a configured compatible profile or block with a settings action.
If a governance/verifier/adjudicator/certifier lane is unconfigured for required work, block with exact configuration action; do not silently downgrade to a low-end executor.
If user changes providers, lane bindings update through Settings/policy, not canonical Plan edits.

lanes.may: execute, inspect, propose patches, return structured outputs
lanes.must_not: certify parent GoalRun completion or decide global authority/routing
lanes.purpose: Bounded WorkNode execution and bounded subagent tasks.

lanes.may: review bounded outputs and produce findings
lanes.purpose: Routine bounded review, simple acceptance checks, evidence mapping.
Goal decomposition, WorkGraph shaping, authority/write-surface decisions, replans, blocker classification, route selection.

lanes.must_not: mark GoalRun complete without certifier receipt
lanes.purpose: Verification checks split between bounded low-cost checks and higher-reasoning reducer/certification depending risk.
Repeated defects, conflicting verifier results, owner ambiguity, root-cause replans.

lanes.may: certify completion when evidence supports it
lanes.must_not: certify with unresolved findings or stale evidence
lanes.purpose: WorkNode receipt certification and GoalRun completion certification.

settings_requirements: Settings must show lane-to-provider/model profile bindings based on configured providers/accounts.
Settings must expose unconfigured or insufficient-capability lanes before runs that require them.
Settings may offer recommended defaults only from configured providers; Plans must not name fixed provider/model defaults.
Cost/budget policy should constrain subagent fanout without weakening required verification gates.
